dataset_name: Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A Surface Reflectance Context Layer

imagery_details.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 (ESA) via Google Earth Engine / Copernicus Open Access Hub
imagery_details.composite_type: Cloud-free dry-season True Color (RGB) & False Color (NIR-Red-Green)
derived_indices: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) for vegetation/mine excavation footprint tracking

data_provenance.usage_in_minepulse: Provides high-resolution optical surface context, open-cast pit boundary reference, and regional vegetation/land-use backdrop.
data_provenance.limitation_note: Optical satellite imagery observes surface terrain and excavation footprint. It does not penetrate subsurface geological layers to measure underground manganese reserve tonnage directly.
